mapper.select: SELECT scene FROM b_marketing_tcyr_sync_record WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND is_del = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: update b_marketing_tcyr_sync_record set down_status = #{downStatus} where batch_no = #{batchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT cell_md5 AS cell FROM b_marketing_sync_${apiCode} WHERE status = 1 AND cust_num =#{userKey} AND is_repeat in (1,2) ORDER BY applet_time DESC LIMIT 1
